connectionProvenance: Supabase Management API direct HTTPS query via personal access token

preTest.provenance: Supabase Management API direct HTTPS query via personal access token

newsroomSessions.query: select coalesce(sp.email, 'unknown_staff') as email, count(*)::int as count from public.newsroom_sessions ns left join public.staff_profiles sp on ns.staff_profile_id = sp.id where ns.revoked_at is null group by sp.email;

authSessions.query: select coalesce(u.email, 'unknown_user') as email, count(*)::int as count from auth.sessions s left join auth.users u on s.user_id = u.id group by u.email;

refreshTokens.query: select coalesce(u.email, 'unknown_user') as email, count(*)::int as count from auth.refresh_tokens rt left join auth.sessions s on rt.session_id = s.id left join auth.users u on s.user_id = u.id where rt.revoked is false group by u.email;
